ld.name: Swanson Vitamins, Vitamins D3 & K2, 60 Veggie Caps
ld.description: Bone and Immune Health 2-In-1 Formula Vegan Dietary Supplement Contains Vitashine D3™ Better together! Emerging research suggests that vitamins D3 and K2—two key nutrients for efficient calcium usage in the body—may have an even more beneficial effect when taken together. Swanson Vitamins D3 & K2 offers these bone and heart health helpers in a convenient, one-a-day veggie capsule. What if you already supplement with vitamins D and K or get them from your diet? Now Swanson offers a low-dose D3 & K2 combo just for you. Swanson low dose Vitamins D3 & K2 provides 50 mcg (2,000 IU) of vegan D3 derived from lichen and 75 mcg soy-free chickpea-sourced K2 as MK-7 in a once-daily veggie cap to help maintain cardiovascular health and promote strong, healthy bones.

blocks.label: Overview
paragraphs: Better together! Emerging research suggests that vitamins D3 and K2—two key nutrients for efficient calcium usage in the body—may have an even more beneficial effect when taken together. Swanson Vitamins D3 & K2 offers these bone and heart health helpers in a convenient, one-a-day veggie capsule.

What if you already supplement with vitamins D and K or get them from your diet? Now Swanson offers a low-dose D3 & K2 combo just for you. Swanson low dose Vitamins D3 & K2 provides 50 mcg (2,000 IU) of vegan D3 derived from lichen and 75 mcg soy-free chickpea-sourced K2 as MK-7 in a once-daily veggie cap to help maintain cardiovascular health and promote strong, healthy bones.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: As a dietary supplement, take one veggie capsule per day with food and water.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Rice flour, hypromellose (vegetarian capsule), microcrystal- line cellulose (plant fiber), maltodextrin, silica, cornstarch.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: For adults only. Do not take this product if you have a renal disorder or if you are pregnant or nursing. Consult your healthcare provider before use if you have a medical condition or if you are taking medication, especially blood thinning medication.
Keep out of reach of children. Do not use if seal is broken. Store in a cool, dry place.
